assumptions.choice: Default the parameterizable 20-period moving average to SMA (self.p.ma_type='SMA', with 'EMA' also supported via the same parameter)
assumptions.reason: Spec says the MA is 'parameterizable as SMA or EMA' but names no default; SMA chosen as the more literal reading of 'moving average' absent further qualification.

assumptions.choice: Manage both the MA-cross exit and the 2% stop-loss via close-based checks inside next(), rather than attaching separate bt.Order stop orders
assumptions.reason: Spec explicitly offers 'attach stop orders OR manage stops intrabar using close-based checks' as alternatives; close-based checks were chosen for a single, consistent per-bar evaluation model and to keep the single order-tracking guard from the canonical defaults straightforward.
Spec marks this as optional, and the supplied data feed already contains only regular-session 5-minute bars (09:30-15:55), making an additional filter redundant.

assumptions.topic: daily reference reset during indicator warm-up
assumptions.choice: Track the day-of-bar and capture reference = day's first bar open in a helper called from both prenext() and next()
assumptions.reason: next() is only invoked once backtrader's automatic minperiod (from ATR/MA) is satisfied, which can be after the first day's true opening bar; using prenext() as well ensures the reference is captured from the actual first 5-minute bar of each day, per spec, even during the warm-up window.
